text:
anya: Kicking off v2 staged rollout to prod-us in ~5m. Target: 10% -> 25% over 20m if stable. Will monitor p95 and auth/quota errors.

deploybot: Canary plan: rollout-id r-214, start at 6143216800, initial 10% traffic. Thresholds set: errors > 1.2% OR p95 > 1.8x baseline -> pause.

cal: Quick FYI - one of the middleware changes in v2 changes how streaming frames are counted for quota. We added a new frame-type tag and the meter increment path might be called twice in edge-proxy. Haven't seen it in staging yet.

ravi: Which tenants do we have on high-throughput reserved plans? I can target pinbacks for them proactively.

cal: Top list: tenant-7f, tenant-44, tenant-salesforce. If we see token spikes we should pin those first.

ops-qa: Canary started at 6143216800. Initial telemetry: overall errors 0.3%, p95 steady. Watching per-tenant now.

deploybot: Update: canary progressed to 25% at 6143216820.

ops-qa: Alert: tenant-44 saw a burst of 429s at ~6143216830. Rate ~3x baseline for that tenant, 0.6% of global traffic but concentrated.

anya: Pause rollout. deploybot, apply pin for tenant-44 and tenant-7f to v1, and throttle retries at the edge for streaming.

deploybot: Executing pause and pins now. Commands applied:
```
/deploy pause r-214
/deploy pin tenant-44 v1
/deploy pin tenant-7f v1
```
Pins live on edge in ~18s. Canary paused at 6143216840.

cal: I dug into the logs: streaming handler emitted two meter increments when a CONTINUE frame followed a DATA frame within the same event loop tick. PR #912 fixes the guard.

ravi: Can we hotpatch only the edge-proxy canary nodes first? If CI green, push edge-only fix and re-run a small canary to validate.

cal: Yep. Prepared image tag `edge-v2.0.2-hotfix-1`. No model changes. CI green on unit + integration.

ops-qa: After pinback, tenant-44 429s stopped. Global error rate back to baseline.

anya: Good. Plan: cut hotfix image, deploy to canary edge nodes, validate 10m. If stable, resume staged rollout but add an extra canary step: 10% -> 15% -> 25% with 10m holds. Also add note to release notes.

release-notes-bot: Draft entry created: "v2 initial rollout: streaming frame double-counting could trigger reserved quota 429s for a subset of tenants. Hotfix edge-v2.0.2-hotfix-1 deployed; affected tenants pinned to v1 during mitigation."

ops-qa: Will open a short follow-up incident thread if we find more affected tenants. For the moment, closing this thread after hotfix validation.

cal: Filing PR backport to stable branch and adding an integration test for framing edge-case.

anya: Thanks everyone. After we confirm the hotfix for 10m on canary, I'll re-initiate the staged rollout with the new hold points.
